title: Anjaneya
desc: A police officer goes undercover to infiltrate the mafia and collect incriminating evidence. During his operation, he receives assistance from Divya, who begins to have romantic feelings for him.

title: Raja Mariyadhai
desc: Raghuram, working for an authoritarian man Rajasekar, attempts to conceal his marriage as his boss is opposed to the concept of marriage.

title: Udhaya
desc: Udhaya falls in love with Vasanthi, but realises that she is already engaged. Later, when he is wrongly framed for a crime, she strives to prove his innocence.

title: Chinna Durai
desc: Chinnadurai, a village do-gooder, helps people in distress but earns the enmity of a fellow villager Ponnambalam. Later, Ponnambalam tries to poison Chinnadurai, but he survives.

title: Thangamana Purushan
desc: Raja and Subalatha fall in love with each other. However, Raja's father, Aldapu Arumugam, and Subalatha's mother, Kanchanamala, are both extremely greedy and refuse to accept their relationship.
